chart.name: Average Processed tokens per request
chart.programText:
A = data('ProcessedPromptTokens', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled'), extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('AzureOpenAIRequests', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled'), extrapolation='zero').dimensions(renames={"ModelDeploymentName": "modeldeploymentname"}).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().top(10).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Top Invocations by Latency overview by model
chart.programText:
A = data('AzureOpenAITTLTInMS', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled'), rollup='average', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).mean(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).mean(by=['modeldeploymentname']).top(count=10).publish(label='A')

C = data('AzureOpenAITTLTInMS', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled'), rollup='min', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).min(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).min(by=['modeldeploymentname']).top(count=10).publish(label='C')
